audit_items.proof_trace: The two-step fixed-point computation `amount.mul(borrow_index).div(self.borrow_index)` introduces at most 1 WAD unit (10^-18 token) of rounding loss per accrual call due to intermediate truncation. The protocol explicitly acknowledges this in asset.move:10-15 and mitigates it via `min_borrow_amount`: any position above this floor accrues interest correctly because the per-period interest term (proportional to amount × rate × time) far exceeds the maximum 1-unit truncation error under any realistic rate and time-step combination. The property holds under correct admin configuration.
